entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for User, Session, and Agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and provides connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent memory provider uses the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading. It is an AGPL-3.0 open-source context database designed to reduce token spend.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agents extracts entity relationships into a knowledge graph without requiring LLM calls. It supports local deployment via PGLite and generates cited prose answers while identifying missing information gaps.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system supports long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents. It provides an LLM wrapper and is accessible through Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library for building stateful agents provides a FastAPI server for managed or self-hosted use. It supports Python and TypeScript SDKs and offers hybrid search with prompt-ready context injection.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like versioning via brv vc commit, branch, and merge. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency memory system uses a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and provides a Python SDK for direct operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context using local infrastructure like Qdrant and Redis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive context harness generates playbooks, hints, and datasets from agent runs to assist with complex tasks. It is available as a Python or TypeScript/Node CLI and library and provides MCP server functionality.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This lossless context management plugin uses a DAG-based engine and a SQLite-backed message store to prevent message loss. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG and provides tools for searching compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer provides portable identity and memory state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It automates memory creation from transcripts and files, achieving a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems using an open, plain-text YAML format called engrams. It enables local-first, zero-cost search for Hermes and other agent environments.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It utilizes hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, to integrate with agents via MCP and specialized hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to preserve accuracy while saving up to 36% in tokens.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory provides durable, file-based long-term storage using SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. The project features a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin offers explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It supports an embedded mode by default and includes a self-directing loop to identify and address knowledge gaps.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It functions as an MCP-native server designed for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes and supports automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless system uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth for cross-project agent memory. It stores data as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to ensure agents load only the context they actually need. This local-first approach renders context to assistant-specific files, resulting in 94% fewer prompt tokens.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces Hermes Agent schema overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool keywords. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features an importance ranking system from 1-10 to prioritize high-priority recall and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports real, immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session AI memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates and searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate payments via a TypeScript SDK.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution via Rust FFI or HTTP daemon. It features HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing for diverse recall methods.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This reusable plugin provides five native tools for managing and searching local artifacts. It includes a proactive router skill and supports an opt-in process for automatic tool-OKF generation.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid search methods. It combines BM25, vector, and graph methods and features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories through semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A with file-and-line citations and runs locally over localhost.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes a subagent-driven-development methodology for task execution. It includes specific phases for brainstorming and design refinement to support agentic software development.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 formats. It is compatible with various coding agents and local CLI executables, including Hermes Agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions using a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It offers client support for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 security domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It features built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities for natural language diagram generation.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It is compatible with Hermes, Cursor, Claude Code, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement to unify skills across multiple agents and devices. It integrates with Hermes, OpenClaw, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills that preserve state within a docs/ folder. These spec-conformant Agent Plugins are compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It integrates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 delegated permissions, x402 payments, escrow, and dispute resolution.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 822 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It provides ready-to-paste exports for use with ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, and Codex.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation through slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set provides access to YouTube transcripts, search, channels, and playlists via the TranscriptAPI. It is compatible with the Agent Skills format and works with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It provides findings alongside a report detailing analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library supports modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts for Pydantic AI. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill generates.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents using a three-level work model. It provides file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files. It automates the capture of high-value decisions and outcomes to create a pipeline for fine-tuning replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This toolkit integrates CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds for oracle network and smart contract interaction. It follows the Agent Skills specification and includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository provides Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides prompting guides and API integration for FLUX.2 and FLUX.1 models. It includes code examples and a suite of six specialized FLUX 3 video skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool extracts function signatures and types from code and documentation to create agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides version-pinned skills with an audit trail.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes TON-based commerce features.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It provides real-time tracking of progress and decisions alongside built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This Intent as Code workflow language uses a single Rust binary to manage AI tasks via four verbs. It enables local-first execution with any model and provides static auditing and tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using WebDAV and CalDAV. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.

entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill employs a 5-layer retrieval system, including semantic embeddings and hard triggers, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token usage and allows for graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to specific model families and tracks token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only tool uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial bug-hunting during code reviews. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec via a deterministic pre-scan layer to identify integration risks and edge cases.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub facilitates community skill browsing and one-click installation using the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine for state management and a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This.NET implementation of agentskills.io integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill uses a three-agent swarm to target code hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness. It features a risk-tiered triage system and language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab provides 2,077 total skills and 131+ tools for network, forensics, and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC via Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard, making it a functional skill for Hermes Agent.

entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: Generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. The skill produces structured reports with core conclusions and utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: Offers a suite of tools including video-to-text for local or Douyin links, document OCR for PDFs and scans, and AI text de-humanization. These tools are compatible with the agentskills.io open standard.

entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer enables the Hermes AI assistant on Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via Termux cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides Hermes Agent sandboxing through hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It allows for kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access and configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via REST, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This production package can run as a TUI, Desktop app, or Gateway. It includes bundled CPython 3.12 and PortableGit, and supports side-by-side execution with an installed Hermes instance.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multi-agent LLM financial trading, incorporating fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It facilitates structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers and supports Docker deployment.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend. It supports various frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini. It offers container sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration. It supports over 23 LLM providers and provides visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system features a Kanban board and review queues to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis. It is designed for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs using Hermes and Ollama without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes and other coding agents. It runs entirely on local hardware across Windows, macOS, and Linux, featuring an auto-sync capability to keep the graph current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool and visualization dashboard that tracks token usage and associated costs for multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It monitors local data files to provide detailed analytics on consumption across various models and providers.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from agents like Hermes, Claude Code, and Cursor while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent-to-provider communications.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help developers build better user interfaces with AI. It integrates directly with Hermes, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, supporting any AI provider that utilizes markdown or general prompting.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes and other CLI tools directly from local paths. It distinguishes itself by synchronizing usage data and session details across multiple machines simultaneously.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications. It comes pre-loaded with 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the terminal UI of Hermes with various community-contributed themes, such as retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. It uses a YAML-based configuration system to modify visual elements like banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing identity registration with human-readable handles and encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It enables Hermes agents to engage in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring OAuth or external processes. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM and GGUF inference as well as reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar to manage complex workflows. It supports multiple providers like Anthropic and OpenAI while offering a unique undo functionality for recent agent-driven changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This repository provides a suite of integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph, alongside editor tooling for VS Code. It includes a specific plugin for Claude Code designed to capture prompts and tool traces for analysis.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve reported token savings of 90-99% during agent operations. It features over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and research, supported by an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder local configurations, skills, and memories. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents through project-local instructions and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services to enable rapid deployment. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic, local checks on AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It analyzes multiple file formats to detect issues such as conflicting directives or missing limits using HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps existing configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing to discover, monitor, and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides fully local, offline interaction with no API keys or accounts required. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, featuring adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.

entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and Codex. It supports delegation to sub-agents within a single task and provides native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It includes embedded terminal access for system repair and native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Tauri-based desktop application designed primarily for Windows and macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime and supports Markdown and LaTeX rendering.

entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents. It provides mobile management of agent sessions, tasks, and skills, alongside read-only access to analytics and memory.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop workspace featuring one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring diffs and code writes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS application that serves as a session browser and agent cockpit. It offers searchable history for ten supported agent sources and live per-session quota burn tracking with local-only data processing.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent running on Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. The interface includes a kanban board for task management and tools for managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted AI assistance. It provides real-time log streaming, a file browser, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It enables real-time tracking of session activity and costs, alongside read-only inspection of environment variables and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client designed for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
